title: With or Without You to Dani California

cues.text: Bono wrote the first chords of With or Without You. It came alive when the Edge played a prototype Infinite Guitar from Michael Brook. Its loop is the axis: one, five, six minor, four.

sources.title: U2, With or Without You (Hooktheory TheoryTab, chords)

cues.text: Madonna's Like a Prayer now sings over Bono's band. She wrote it with Patrick Leonard in about three hours, shaped by her Catholic upbringing. It turns the same four chords.

sources.title: Madonna, Like a Prayer (Hooktheory TheoryTab, chords)

cues.text: Dani California now rides Madonna's band. It turns six minor, five, two minor, a move Like a Prayer also makes.

sources.title: Madonna, Like a Prayer (Hooktheory TheoryTab, chords)

cues.text: Anthony Kiedis traced Dani through earlier songs. The video dresses the band as rock acts from Elvis and the Beatles to Hendrix and Bowie.
